newsitem.title: USA: USF&G Corp Q4 oper shr rises.
newsitem.headline: USF&G Corp Q4 oper shr rises.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
Note: Net income in the 1996 fourth quarter was $102 million compared with $65 million a year ago.
Net income was $0.84 a share on a primary per share basis in the 1996 fourth quarter compared with $0.52 a year ago.
On a fully diluted basis, net income was $0.79 a share in the 1996 fourth quarter compared to $0.48 a share a year ago.

Operating income is defined as net income, excluding realized gains and losses on investments net of income taxes, facilities exit costs or income, branch reorganization severance and deferred income tax benefits.
Property-casualty operating income was $65 million in the fourth quarter of 1996 compared with $64 million a year ago.
For 1996, property-casualty operating income was $213 million compared with $240 million in 1995.
Life insurance operating income was $13 million in the fourth quarter of 1996 compared with $8 million a year ago.
For 1996, life insurance operating income was $49 million compared with $27 million a year ago.
